evd_title: Three AI platforms responded correctly to all 10 IRB case study queries
finding: Three AI platforms responded correctly to all 10 IRB case study queries
P: 10 FERCAP/SIDCER handbook ethics case studies x 3 platforms = 30 responses; health research ethics
I: Poe Assistant, ChatGPT (GPT-3.5), Google Bard; prompted with open-ended questions
C: FERCAP/SIDCER handbook + ICH E6 GCP; 2 author reviewers
O: All 3 answered 10/10 cases; >=1 platform missed GCP sub-issues in 9 domains; all 3 missed post-trial access (case 10); no score or IAA
